resources.string: Open and view documents, spreadsheets, slides and photos. Everything renders on your phone, nothing is uploaded.
Files you open appear here for quick access.

Grant a folder (for example Documents, DCIM, or any folder you create) to browse its files right here. Android does not allow granting the Downloads root, but its subfolders work. Gander itself needs no storage permission.
Nothing to show in this folder.

PDF · Word (.docx) · Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .csv, .ods) · PowerPoint (.pptx) · Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, SVG and more) · Video (MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and more) · Audio (MP3, FLAC, WAV, OGG and more) · Markdown · Text, JSON and code files
Tip: in your file manager, tap any file and choose Open with > Gander.
